'''Jurzan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], on the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]].

The planet was the site of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] refueling station during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
